title: Podgora Couples Guide: Romantic Getaways 2027
metaDescription: Romantic things to do in Podgora, Croatia in 2027: quiet coves, sunset dinners, Biokovo Skywalk, island boat trips, where to stay and what it costs in euros.
content:
## Why Podgora Works for Couples

Podgora is a small town on the Makarska Riviera, between the Adriatic and the Biokovo mountain range. It has about 5.5 km of coastline, more than 2,750 sunshine hours a year, and a calmer pace than Makarska, 9 km to the south-east. Evenings are for walking the seafront and eating fish. There is no club scene. That is the main reason to choose it over Makarska for a romantic trip.

**Opinion:** For a couple, Podgora is a better base than Makarska. It has the same beaches, ferries and excursions within 15 minutes by car or bus, with far fewer crowds after dark.

## Best Beaches for Couples in Podgora

### Plišivac Beach
Plišivac lies just north of the centre. Fine pebbles, pine shade and very clear water make it the best all-day beach in town. Arrive before 10:00 in July and August to get a spot under the trees. Bring sea shoes, as sea urchins live on the rocks.

### Garma Beach
Garma is a pebble cove about 25 minutes on foot north of the centre. It is the most private option near town, with no beach bars and little infrastructure. Pack water, snacks and shade, and walk there in the morning before the heat builds.

### Klokun Beach
Klokun, between Čaklje and Drašnice, is a good choice for snorkelling in clear water. Facilities are minimal, so bring a picnic.

### Podgora Town Beach
The central beach has changing facilities and rental sunbeds and umbrellas, with cafes right behind it. It is the easiest option for a short swim and a drink. Expect sunbed prices of roughly €10-20 per pair in high season.

## Romantic Things to Do in Podgora

### Walk the Seafront at Sunset
The promenade runs from the harbour past the beaches and is car-free in the centre. Sunset in July is around 20:30. The Seagull Wings Monument, a large memorial above the town, has an amphitheatre with views over the bay and is a quiet spot for the last light.

### Visit the Biokovo Skywalk
The glass-floored Skywalk sits at 1,228 m inside Biokovo Nature Park. Park entry runs around €10–15 per person depending on season, and guided cabrio, Land Rover and tuk-tuk tours from the Makarska area start at about €56-67 per person. Sunset and morning departures avoid the midday heat, which can be severe in summer. Take a jacket, because the summit is clearly cooler than the coast.

### Take a Speedboat Day Trip
The most popular excursion is the 5-hour 3-island speedboat tour from Makarska to Brač, Hvar and Zečevo. It includes a cave swim and a stop at the Blue Lagoon. Prices start around €77 per person. A private option is a self-drive licence-free boat, for roughly €50-90 per group depending on hours and boat size. It suits couples who want quiet bays without a group.

### Go Kayaking or Snorkelling
Sea kayaks can be rented along the Podgora and Makarska coast. Paddle early, when the sea is flat, and stay close to the shore.

### Day Trip to Omiš or Krka
Omiš, with its canyon mouth and river, is about 40 km north. The Krka waterfalls day trip from the Riviera takes a full day and is better booked in spring or autumn.

## Where to Eat and Drink in Podgora

- **Roko Restaurant:** Central seafront spot for fish, meat and pasta. It is the usual choice for sunset tables, so reserve for 19:30-20:00 in summer.
- **Restaurant Vruja:** Known for carefully presented fish and seafood.
- **Konoba Klemić:** Traditional home-style Dalmatian cooking on Obala Petra Krešimira.
- **Portobello Bar Pizzeria:** Casual, for a cheaper pizza night.
- **Banana Bar:** Cocktails and live music on the beach side.
- **Kuka Wine & Spirit Bar:** Quieter evening drinks.

Expect €25-45 per person for a fish dinner with wine. Grilled fish is usually priced by weight, around €60-80 per kg, so ask the price before ordering.

## Where to Stay

Medora Auri Family Beach Resort is a 4-star hotel on the car-free promenade with direct access to a pebble beach and heated outdoor pools. Despite the name, it works well for couples in the shoulder season. Podgora also has private villas and apartments on the hillside, with sea views and pools. These typically cost several hundred euros per night in high season, and the top-end villas cost considerably more.

**Insider tip:** Rooms and apartments on the hillside above the old coastal road give the best views, but the walk back up is steep. Check the access route before booking.

## Best Time to Visit

| Period | Sea temperature | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| May-June | 18-22°C | Quiet, mild, good for hiking Biokovo |
| July-August | 24-26°C | Hottest, busiest, highest prices |
| September | 22-24°C | Warm sea, fewer crowds, best value |

September is the best month for couples. The sea is at its warmest and prices drop from the August peak.

## Getting There

Split Airport is about 75 km away, roughly 1 hour by car. Makarska has regular buses, and a taxi from Split Airport typically costs €90-120. A rental car helps for Garma, Klokun and Biokovo.

## Local Tips for Couples

1. Book sunset tables at least one day ahead from late June to August.
2. Go to Biokovo first thing in the morning, or at sunset, to avoid heat and tour buses.
3. Wear water shoes on all pebble coves.
4. Carry cash for small beach kiosks and for parking near the coves.
5. Medora Hotels often include an excursion such as a Skywalk or island boat trip with direct bookings, so check their offers before booking a tour separately.

faq.question: Is Podgora good for couples?
faq.answer: Yes. Podgora has quiet pine-shaded beaches, a car-free seafront and a calmer evening atmosphere than Makarska. Its location also puts the Biokovo Skywalk and island boat trips within easy reach.

faq.question: What is the most romantic beach in Podgora?
faq.answer: Garma Beach is the most private, a pebble cove about 25 minutes on foot north of the centre. Plišivac is the best option if you want pine shade and easier access.

faq.question: How much does a romantic dinner in Podgora cost?
faq.answer: A fish dinner with wine in a seafront restaurant costs about €25-45 per person. Whole grilled fish is priced by weight at around €60-80 per kg, so confirm the price when ordering.

faq.question: Can you visit the Biokovo Skywalk from Podgora?
faq.answer: Yes. Biokovo Nature Park is a short drive away. Park entry is around €10–15 per person depending on season, and guided tours from the Makarska area start at about €56 per person.

faq.question: What is the best month for a couples trip to Podgora?
faq.answer: September is the best month. The sea is around 22-24°C, crowds are smaller and prices are lower than in July and August.

faq.question: How do you get from Split Airport to Podgora?
faq.answer: Podgora is about 75 km from Split Airport, roughly 1 hour by car. Options are a rental car, a Makarska-bound bus, or a private transfer at about €90-120.

quickAnswer: Podgora suits couples who want a quiet Makarska Riviera base with pine-shaded beaches, sunset dinners and mountain views. The best plan: swim at Plišivac or Garma, eat at a seafront restaurant at sunset, ride up to the Biokovo Skywalk, and take a speedboat day trip to Hvar and Brač (from about €77 per person).
